title: Executive Assistant (Talent Coordination)
why_it_fits: Executive Assistant match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
We're looking for a sharp, high-agency Executive Assistant to own recruiting, offshore staff training, and operational support for a fast-growing AI healthcare startup. This is a generalist role built for someone who is genuinely all-around capable - someone who picks up new systems fast, runs independently, and delivers outcomes without needing a playbook handed to them.

You will spend a significant portion of your time recruiting and training offshore staff, but this role extends beyond that. You will also support navigation, operations, and other projects as they arise.
key_responsibilities:
as the business evolves

What You Bring
- Exceptional written and spoken English fluency at a professional or near-native level - this is required for a training and communication-heavy role
- 2 or more years in an executive assistant, chief of staff, operations coordinator, or high-ownership generalist role
- Proven ability to manage multiple complex workflows simultaneously with minimal oversight
- Comfortable training and supporting team members at varying levels of experience and technical ability
- Strong organizational systems and a track record of following through without being reminded
- Ownership mindset - you surface problems with a proposed solution, not just a flag
- Genuinely versatile and adaptable with the ability to shift between recruiting, training, and operational work without losing quality

Nice to Have
- Prior exposure to recruiting, HR coordination, or candidate management
- Experience training or onboarding offshore or remote team members
- Experience in healthcare, healthtech, or a regulated industry
- Interest in or comfort with AI tools that could automate parts of the workflow
- Background in operations, project coordination, or chief of staff functions

How to Apply

Please include:
- Your updated resume
- A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a high-volume or fast-moving operational challenge you owned independently, and sharing one example of how you adapted quickly to a new scope or responsibility without being asked

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a self-directed generalist who thrives on ownership, picks up new workflows fast, and wants a role with real variety and full autonomy inside a company removing real friction from healthcare, this role gives you the access and the impact to do your best work.
